video_prompts.veo_prompt: Cinematic wide shot, aerial view over Caracas at night, city plunged into darkness with isolated explosions illuminating the skyline. Realistic, urgent atmosphere, tracking camera descending towards chaos.
video_prompts.voiceover: On January 3, 2026, US airstrikes and cyber attacks caused a blackout in Caracas, launching a major military operation targeting Venezuela’s leadership and infrastructure.
video_prompts.actual-content: On January 3, 2026, the US initiated airstrikes and a cyber operation that led to a blackout in Caracas, beginning a military attack aimed at Venezuelan government sites.

video_prompts.veo_prompt: Close-up, dramatic night vision shot of US special forces deploying from helicopters near the presidential palace. Dust, urgency, and tactical precision in a tense, realistic scene.
video_prompts.voiceover: US special operations forces swiftly extracted President Nicolás Maduro and his wife from Caracas, deploying helicopters and ground teams during covert nighttime strikes.
video_prompts.actual-content: US special operations forces entered Caracas using helicopters and ground teams, capturing Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife through a coordinated nighttime assault.

video_prompts.veo_prompt: Perspective from a city street, wide lens, locals in shadows as explosions echo. People huddle, faces illuminated by phones. Atmosphere tense, blue-gray lighting and documentary realism.
video_prompts.voiceover: Venezuelans described chaos and fear as explosions erupted and communications failed, with widespread confusion amid deserted streets and ongoing US-led operations.
video_prompts.actual-content: During the attack, Caracas residents witnessed explosions, loss of communication, and deserted streets, with many expressing shock and fear in real-time accounts.

video_prompts.veo_prompt: Studio-style composition, split screen showing US officials in press conference contrasted with somber Venezuelan leaders, cinematic lighting highlighting tense emotions and serious expressions.
video_prompts.voiceover: US officials claimed the extraction as a law enforcement mission, while Venezuelan leaders denounced it as kidnapping and armed aggression against their sovereignty.
video_prompts.actual-content: US officials described the mission as justified law enforcement; Venezuelan government called it kidnapping and armed aggression violating international norms.

video_prompts.veo_prompt: Global map animation, flags and lines showing reactions from China, Russia, Latin America, and UN. Warm and cool glows distinguish support and condemnation, infographic style.
video_prompts.voiceover: Worldwide, China and Russia condemned the attack while US allies expressed support. The United Nations and Latin American neighbors called it a breach of international law.
video_prompts.actual-content: China, Russia, many Latin American countries, and the UN condemned the US attack; some US allies supported the operation, showing divided global responses.

video_prompts.veo_prompt: Stylized transition, somber montage of US and Venezuelan flags, protest crowds, and screens displaying breaking news. Slow pan, subdued colors, documentary feel.
video_prompts.voiceover: The incident drastically impacts US-Venezuela relations, setting a precedent for regime change and raising fears of instability, mass displacement, and humanitarian crisis.
video_prompts.actual-content: The US operation is expected to reshape US-Venezuela relations, prompting concerns about future regime changes, instability, and humanitarian impacts the attack may cause.
